sources.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Large Language Models: A Survey
sources.snippet: This survey explores the integration of retrieval methods with large language models to address limitations like hallucinations and outdated knowledge.

sources.title: Deploying Large Language Models with Retrieval Augmented Generation
sources.snippet: The contributions of this work include the development of best practices and recommendations for adopting this promising technology while ensuring compliance with industry regulations through a proposed AI governance model. Keywords Retrieval Augmented Generation Large Language Models AI Governance Human Artificial Intelligence Systems

sources.title: What is RAG? - Retrieval-Augmented Generation AI Explained - AWS
sources.snippet: What is Retrieval-Augmented Generation? Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is the process of optimizing the output of a large language model, so it references an authoritative knowledge base outside of its training data sources before generating a response.
